description: This file defines an interface `ISyncBackend` for synchronizing notes, including methods for checking availability, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes, along with associated properties.

classes.name: ISyncBackend
classes.description: Interface specifying synchronization backend operations for notes.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the sync backend is available for operations.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note in the sync backend.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the sync backend.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the sync backend.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note from the sync backend.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the sync backend.
